name: mod-title-capture
purpose: iter-463 mods/ overlay experiment E1 (docs/CUSTOM_FRONTEND.md 7.2, docs/MODS.md). Reaches the PRESS START title exactly as title_readiness_start.json does, requires a visible title, dwells 20 s on it (the capture window for the press-start text), sends ONE START and dwells 25 s on whatever the boot flow raises (LOAD A GAME? with the XAM fix). Run the same scenario with and without a mod (-Gates SR_MODS=<name>) and compare the APT_REQ order, the [MOD] lines and the frames. -TimeoutSeconds 360.
